target_population_or_coverage: Adult population age 18+ in Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales). No groups excluded or under-represented; Scotland and Wales were intentionally over-represented for analysis and post-survey weighting was used for national representativeness.
sample_frame: Royal Mail Postcode Address File (PAF), Small User version, excluding high-volume business addresses.
actual_sampling_design: Two-stage address probability sample: stratified random PPS selection of postcode sectors, then 30 addresses per selected sector from PAF; one adult age 18+ randomly selected within participating household.
positive_design_detail: 273 postcode sectors in Great Britain; 56 in Scotland and 45 in Wales. Stratifiers: country/region, population-density tertiles, percentage owner-occupied. Rare multi-household addresses were randomly subsampled electronically.
data_collection_mode: Mixed mode (CAPI/CAWI/post/video CAPI in deposit metadata)
source_refs: WVSA WVS7 Methodology Report Great Britain 2022 via UK Data Service SN 9311; IHSN catalog 12279 resources 104788/104790
notes: Positive detail only from WVSA methodology; no source-incidence reasoning.
